Import an exported model

Source: R/models.R
laya_import_model.Rd

Adds a checkpoint exported with Laya's export_onnx.py (or downloaded by another tool) to layaR's model root, so laya_engine() finds it by name.

Usage

laya_import_model(
  path,
  checkpoint = c("multilingual", "english", "typed-decisions"),
  method = default_import_method(),
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

path

The export's folder: it holds model.onnx (or encoder.onnx and head.onnx), rl_agent_config.json and the tokenizer.

checkpoint

Which checkpoint the export is.

method

"symlink" links to the folder without copying 1.3 GB; "copy" copies it, so the original can be deleted. The default is "symlink", except on Windows, where links to folders need special permissions and only "copy" is supported.

overwrite

Replace an installed model?

Value

The installed path, invisibly.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
laya_import_model("~/exports/onnx/multilingual", "multilingual")
} # }
